---
title: "Setup and reproducibility"
---

## Required software

- R 4.5 or later
- RStudio Desktop or another R development environment
- Quarto 1.7 or later
- Git

The repository also includes a devcontainer for GitHub Codespaces or a compatible local container environment.

## Restore the R environment

From the repository root, run:

```bash
Rscript scripts/00_setup.R
```

`glmGamPoi` is an optional speed accelerator for the SCTransform comparison.
It is not required by the pinned course environment: when absent,
`SCTransform()` uses its slower built-in fitting path and may print an
informational fallback message.

The setup script installs `renv` when necessary and restores the package versions recorded in `renv.lock`. Do not install packages one by one unless troubleshooting a failed restore.

## Verify the installation

```bash
Rscript scripts/check_environment.R
Rscript scripts/generate_synthetic_data.R --check
Rscript scripts/smoke_test_modules_01_03.R
python3 scripts/validate_repository.py
```

Each command should end with an explicit success message. A warning about a package being built under a nearby R patch release is usually harmless; an absent package or failed assertion is not.

## Preview the site

```bash
quarto preview
```

Quarto prints a local URL, usually beginning with `http://localhost:`. Keep the preview process running while working through the lessons.

## Project paths

All course code assumes the working directory is the repository root. Confirm with:

```r
getwd()
file.exists("data/synthetic_qc_counts.rds")
file.exists("labs/01-count-matrix-lab.R")
```

Both `file.exists()` calls should return `TRUE`. If not, open the project file or set the working directory to the cloned repository—not to `data/` or `labs/`.

## Reproducibility record

At the end of a lab, save:

```r
sessionInfo()
```

Record random seeds, package versions, and any changes to provided parameters. A reproducible analysis includes the computational environment and analytical decisions, not only the final figure.
